title: Fill a gear order and hand it to the Portfolio Manager
purpose: Every new site gets a whole kit on the day the schedule names, and every phone in it is enrolled, tested, and signed for.
with: Mano, who holds the store and places every order, and Youssef Medhat, who sends the order
when: The day the order lands from central planning, until the handover on launch day.
takes: The same week from the store. One to two weeks if phones must be bought.

steps.do: Read the order and write the full kit list
steps.detail: Phones, spares at ten percent, mounts, caps, chargers, a strip, labels, signage, and the forms. One kit per ten phones.
steps.check: The list has a count for every item.

steps.do: Count the store against the list with Mano
steps.detail: What is short, Mano orders the same day. Phones take one to two weeks.
steps.check: Youssef Medhat knows today whether the date holds.

steps.do: Enroll every phone in the MDM and tag it
steps.detail: A phone we cannot see on the map does not join a kit. Open its registry row.
steps.check: Every phone shows on the map with its tag.

steps.do: Run one 30-minute test recording on every phone
steps.detail: Watch it upload. A phone that does not upload does not join the kit.
steps.check: Every phone shows one completed upload.

steps.do: Build the kit, label everything, and pack it
steps.time: Before the phones leave the store
steps.detail: Device numbers on the phones, the site on the bags, nothing written on the outside of a bag.
steps.check: The kit matches the list, item by item.

steps.do: Sign the kit out of the store
steps.who: Mano signs it out, you sign for it
steps.check: The registry shows every phone as with you.

steps.do: Hand the kit to the Portfolio Manager and count it together
steps.detail: Count by device number. Both sign the phone list.
steps.check: The Portfolio Manager signed for the whole kit.

steps.do: Update the registry and refill the spare pool
steps.detail: Every phone is now at the site in the Portfolio Manager's name. Reorder anything under ten percent through Mano.
steps.check: The map and the registry match the site. The spare pool is at ten percent.

done: The Portfolio Manager signed for the whole kit on the day the schedule named, and every phone in it is on the map.

fails.if: The store is short and phones will land late
fails.then: Launch day moves. No site launches short. Tell Youssef Medhat and Moharam the same day.

fails.if: A phone will not enroll or never shows on the map
fails.then: It does not join a kit. Set it aside for repair and take another phone.

fails.if: A bag goes missing between the store and the site
fails.then: Call Moharam now. The tech support specialist puts every phone on the list in lost mode within the hour.

fails.if: The Portfolio Manager's count is not your count
fails.then: Nobody signs. Find the device number behind the difference before anyone leaves.

fails.if: The spare pool falls under ten percent
fails.then: Mano orders the same day. Tell Youssef Medhat so the schedule does not count on phones that are not there.

escalate: Moharam the same day for a launch that will not hold or a lost phone. Mano the same day for the order or the registry.
